verdict.rationale: Fathom's API covers core meeting data (list meetings, transcripts, summaries, downloads, webhooks, users/permissions) and SDKs/webhooks, but there's no evidence the API exposes many UI-surfaced features like CRM field sync, Deal View, coaching scorecards, playlists/clips, comments/folders/keyword alerts, or custom bot configuration — these appear only as pricing-page features, not documented endpoints. missing for 10: API endpoints for CRM sync, playlists/clips, comments/keyword alerts, coaching scorecards, and custom bot settings; no OpenAPI spec found (404s) suggesting incomplete API surface documentation.
